And if you also need encrypted email, a password manager, a calendar, and 500 GB of cloud storage, Proton Unlimited at €7.99/month bundles every Proton service together. ## In-Depth Proton VPN Analysis

### Privacy and Security: The Gold Standard

Proton VPN is, without exaggeration, the most transparent and heavily audited VPN on the market. Here are the facts:

**5 Consecutive No-Logs Audits (2022-2026):** Securitum, one of Europe's most respected security auditing firms (it oversees more than 300 security projects a year for banks and major corporations), has spent several days each year at Proton's facilities examining server configurations, infrastructure code, and operational procedures, and interviewing staff. The conclusion across all 5 audits: Proton VPN stores no records of user activity whatsoever. And unlike the competition, Proton publishes the full reports openly — no NDAs, no sign-up required, nothing hidden behind a login.

**Audit Transparency Comparison:**

| VPN | No-Logs Audits | Full Report Published? |
|---|---|---|
| **Proton VPN** | 5 (Securitum, 2022-2026) | ✅ Yes, openly |
| **ExpressVPN** | 27+ audits (Cure53) | ❌ NDA required to download |
| **NordVPN** | 4 (Deloitte/PwC) | ❌ Visible to customers only |
| **Surfshark** | 2+ (Deloitte) | ❌ Login required to view |
| **CyberGhost** | 1 (Deloitte) | ❌ Must be requested from Deloitte |

**Swiss Jurisdiction:** Proton AG is headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland — a country with some of the strictest data protection laws in the world. Switzerland is not an EU member, doesn't belong to the 5/9/14 Eyes surveillance alliances, and under the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP), Proton VPN has no legal obligation to retain logs. Proton VPN has also been put to the test in more than 400 legal cases: in every single one, the answer was "we have no data to share" because the logs simply don't exist.

**100% Open Source:** Every Proton VPN app (Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android) is fully open source. Anyone can inspect the code, compile it independently, and verify that it does exactly what Proton says it does. That's backed up by a bug bounty program that rewards security researchers for finding vulnerabilities.

**Secure Core:** This is one of Proton VPN's most innovative features. Secure Core routes your traffic through multiple servers before it reaches the internet: it first passes through a Secure Core server housed in a hardened data center in Switzerland, Iceland, or Sweden (countries with extremely strong privacy protections), then exits through an endpoint server in the country of your choice. That means even if a sophisticated attacker compromises the exit server, they can never discover your real IP or tie your activity to your identity. Secure Core servers are owned and operated directly by Proton (not rented from third parties), with fully encrypted disks.

**NetShield (Ad and Malware Blocker):** NetShield is Proton VPN's DNS filtering system, blocking ads, trackers, and malware at the network level. It works on three levels: block malware only, block malware + trackers, or block malware + trackers + ads. By filtering at the DNS level, NetShield cuts down the data you need to load and speeds up browsing — on top of protecting you from known malicious sites.

**Military-Grade Encryption:** Proton VPN uses AES-256-GCM to encrypt traffic, 4096-bit RSA key exchange, HMAC with SHA384 for message authentication, and perfect forward secrecy (PFS). With PFS, a new encryption key is generated every time you connect, so a key is never used for more than one session. That means your encrypted traffic can't be captured and decrypted later, even if a future key is compromised.

**Leak Protection:** Proton VPN includes DNS, IPv6, and WebRTC leak protection across all its apps. The kill switch blocks all internet traffic if the VPN connection drops unexpectedly, available as a standard kill switch (per app) or a permanent kill switch (system-wide). That said, some user reviews on Trustpilot mention occasional kill switch failures on certain platforms — worth keeping in mind if your work demands absolute anonymity.

### Speed and Performance

**VPN Accelerator:** Proton's flagship speed technology. VPN Accelerator uses a set of advanced networking techniques — including rewriting protocol code to support multi-threading, optimized TCP algorithms, and latency-reduction techniques — that can increase VPN speeds by up to 400%. In practice, that means Proton VPN can turn slow connections into usable ones and fast connections into excellent ones.

**10 Gbps Infrastructure:** All Proton VPN Plus servers run on 10 Gbps connections, which means server-side bandwidth will never be the bottleneck.

**Speed Test Results (data from CyberInsider, February 2026):**

| Server Location | Download (Mbps) | Loss vs Baseline |
|---|---|---|
| Baseline (no VPN) | ~500 Mbps | 0% |
| Local Server (Europe) | ~440 Mbps | ~12% |
| New York (US) | ~395 Mbps | ~21% |
| Los Angeles (US) | ~370 Mbps | ~26% |
| United Kingdom (long distance) | ~410 Mbps | ~18% |

With WireGuard (the recommended protocol), Proton VPN competes respectably but doesn't lead. NordVPN with NordLynx (~4-6% loss) and ExpressVPN with Lightway (~8-10% loss) deliver higher speeds. For most users on connections under 500 Mbps, the difference will be imperceptible. On gigabit connections, NordVPN and ExpressVPN will squeeze out more bandwidth.

**Available Protocols:**
- **WireGuard:** The fastest, most modern protocol. Recommended for everyday use.
- **Stealth:** A proprietary obfuscation protocol built to evade detection on restrictive networks (China, Iran, Russia, UAE). It uses advanced techniques to make VPN traffic look like normal HTTPS traffic.
- **OpenVPN (UDP/TCP):** The industry standard. Good compatibility, proven security.
- **IKEv2/IPSec:** Fast and well suited to mobile devices (quick reconnection when switching networks).

## FAQ - Frequently Asked Questions

### Is Proton VPN safe and trustworthy?
Proton VPN is exceptionally safe and trustworthy. It operates under Swiss jurisdiction (outside 5/9/14 Eyes), uses AES-256-GCM encryption with perfect forward secrecy, has passed 5 consecutive third-party audits of its no-logs infrastructure by Securitum (2022-2026), publishes every audit report openly, and keeps all of its apps 100% open source. Its Secure Core servers and NetShield add extra layers of protection. The one caveat: some users report occasional kill switch failures in certain configurations.

### How much does Proton VPN cost?
Proton VPN Plus costs €2.99/month on the 2-year plan (billed €71.76 for the first 24 months), €4.49/month on the annual plan, or €9.99/month month-to-month. Proton Unlimited (all Proton services) costs €7.99/month on the 2-year plan. There's also a free version (Proton Free) with no data caps, no ads, and no selling of your data — the best free VPN on the market.

### Does Proton VPN keep logs?
No. Proton VPN operates under a strict no-logs policy. It does not store: browsing history, traffic destinations, DNS queries, connection timestamps, session durations, bandwidth usage, or IP addresses (original or assigned). This policy has been independently verified by Securitum across 5 consecutive annual audits (2022-2026), and the full reports are public. On top of that, Proton VPN has responded to more than 400 legal requests without being able to provide data, because it doesn't exist.

### Does Proton VPN work with Netflix?
Yes, Proton VPN works with Netflix in 2026. The Plus servers are optimized to unblock multiple regional libraries including Netflix US, UK, Canada, Japan, and Germany. If a server stops working, Proton typically updates it within 24-48 hours. Consistency is good, but not at the level of NordVPN or ExpressVPN.

### How fast is Proton VPN?
Proton VPN delivers good but not industry-leading speeds. With WireGuard, typical speed loss is 10-15% on local connections and 18-26% on long-distance connections. VPN Accelerator can significantly improve performance on slow connections (up to 400%), and the 10 Gbps infrastructure ensures the server is never the bottleneck. NordVPN (NordLynx, ~4-6% loss) and ExpressVPN (Lightway, ~8-10% loss) are faster in head-to-head testing.

### How many devices can I use with Proton VPN?
You can connect up to 10 devices simultaneously with a Proton VPN Plus or Unlimited subscription. The free plan allows 1 device. Apps are available for Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android, Android TV, Apple TV, Chromebook, plus extensions for Chrome and Firefox. Router configuration extends protection to every device on your home network.

### Does Proton VPN work in China?
Proton VPN can work in China using the Stealth protocol, designed specifically to evade the Great Firewall's deep packet inspection (DPI). Stealth makes VPN traffic look like normal HTTPS traffic. That said, effectiveness in China varies — what works today may not work tomorrow. For consistent use in China, ExpressVPN and Astrill VPN have a stronger track record.

### Does Proton VPN have a free version?
Yes. Proton Free is widely regarded as the best free VPN version on the market. It offers: no ads, no data caps, no data selling, 1 device, medium speed, servers in 10 countries (randomly assigned), and all the privacy protections of the paid plan. The limitations: no streaming, no P2P/torrenting, no Secure Core, no NetShield, and no manual server selection. It's an excellent gateway into the Proton ecosystem.

### Who owns Proton VPN?
Proton VPN is developed and operated by Proton AG, a Swiss company founded in 2014 by CERN scientists (Andy Yen, Jason Stockman, and Wei Sun). Proton AG is independent — it isn't owned by any venture capital conglomerate or big tech corporation. The company is funded primarily through user subscriptions (not by selling data or running ads) and operates under a nonprofit governance structure via the Proton Foundation, which legally obligates the company to prioritize its privacy mission over shareholder profits.
